entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-04
entry.content:

    Backlog

    Backlog

Closed

    .NET 9 SR8

  • Image is mirrored on Windows when FlowDirection is set to RightToLeft #29817
  • Add OnClose confirmation dialog support for macOS (Catalyst) #29819
  • Unable to retrieve certificates from the keychain in a .NET MAUI Mac Catalyst project. Previously, this worked in Xamarin.Mac using similar logic, but now both command-based code and Security APIs are not working as expected in Mac Catalyst. #29816
  • [Testing] Reenable flaky UI test with Issue19509Test #28806
    .NET 9 Servicing

    Backlog
